units.source_text: 架设在岩石与岩石之间的板桥，无一剩下，全都倒塌了。

en.t: The plank bridges built between the rocks had all collapsed, without a single one remaining.

units.source_text: 板桥的一端开了洞眼，穿上铁丝，系在岸上，桥板漂流到河边来。

en.t: A hole had been made in one end of each plank bridge, an iron wire was threaded through it and tied to the bank, and the bridge planks drifted down to the riverside.
